name: Context7
description: Search public library documentation and retrieve current code examples.

methods.whenToUse: Use the public hosted MCP server for read-only library documentation lookups.
methods.guidanceMd: Connect Context7 to resolve public library IDs and retrieve current documentation. Anonymous access is supported with low rate limits; this method does not configure an API key. Keep queries limited to public documentation questions and do not include credentials, personal data, or proprietary code.
warnings: Context7 processes the query text. Do not include secrets, personal information, or proprietary code.
Anonymous requests have low rate limits. Provider documentation says an API key raises limits and supports private repositories; this public method does not configure a key.
